author: bamr87
subject: refactor(prd): rewrite PRD Machine to v2 hybrid marker model
body:
- Rewrite prd-machine.py: marker-based partial updates (4 dynamic
  sections) replacing full 10-section regeneration
- Add check command with section relevance mapping and optional
  AI analysis via GitHub Models API
- Migrate PRD.md with AUTO:BEGIN/END markers for metadata,
  status_line, mvp_status, and edge_issues sections
- Rewrite prd-sync.yml: PR-merge trigger replaces 6-hour cron,
  3-job pipeline (check → sync → check-conflicts), opens PRs
  via peter-evans/create-pull-request instead of direct commits
- Update README.md with v2 docs, marker system, CI/CD integration

Key improvements:
- Hybrid ownership: machines update data, humans own strategy
- PR-driven: changes flow through PRs for review
- Check-before-acting: quick check avoids unnecessary CI noise
- Zero dependencies: stdlib-only Python

subject: chore(posts): organize root _posts into category folders

- Removed 3 byte-identical duplicate root posts (verified via diff):

- Removed stub pages/_posts/system administration/2024-03-27-bootable-mac-os.md
  (had null fields; replaced by rich root version on move)

- Patched scripts/development/content/organize-posts.py extract_slug() to
  prefer the existing filename slug (URL-preserving). Falls back to slug,
  permalink, then title.

- Added section: frontmatter to 5 unclassified root posts so the auto-organizer
  can place them.

- Ran organize-posts.sh: moved 14 root posts into category folders, all
  filename slugs preserved. Apostrophe in sec's-edgar-database normalized
  to secs-edgar-database (script-level sanitization).

- Added TODO/posts-cleanup.md tracker.

Only pages/_posts/2000-01-01-index.md remains at root (intentional landing

author: bamr87
subject: chore(posts): rename _posts subfolders to kebab-case + fix nanobar Liquid
body:
Phase 1b of mass cleanup (chore/posts-mass-cleanup):

Folder renames (8): all spaces and '&' chars removed for shell- and tooling-
friendliness. Jekyll uses 'permalink: pretty' which derives URLs from the
'categories' frontmatter, NOT from _posts subdirectory names — so this rename
has zero URL impact and needs no redirect_from.

  ai & machine learning/    -> ai-machine-learning/
  creative & experimental/  -> creative-experimental/
  culture & society/        -> culture-society/
  data & analytics/         -> data-analytics/
  system administration/    -> system-administration/
  tools & environment/      -> tools-environment/
  trends & ideas/           -> trends-ideas/
  web development/          -> web-development/

Updated _data/posts_organization.yml directory: values to match.

Fixed Liquid build error in 2026-04-19-ai-assisted-nanobar-footer-refactoring.md
by wrapping a documentation '{% include components/nanobar.html %}' example in
{% raw %} tags. The include was a code sample, not a real include.

Verified: docker compose Jekyll build succeeds with only pre-existing warnings.
Frontmatter validity improved 73->72 valid (after removing 4 dupes), errors
102->96, SEO score 54.5->55.1.

author: bamr87
subject: chore(posts): auto-fill missing frontmatter & relocate drafts
body:
Phase 2 of posts mass-cleanup.

Frontmatter normalization (scripts/validation/fix-frontmatter.py):
- Auto-fill date from filename (YYYY-MM-DD-...) when missing
- Auto-fill categories from kebab-case folder name with Title Case +
  '&' restoration map (e.g. ai-machine-learning -> 'AI & Machine Learning')
- Auto-fill description from first prose paragraph (skips code fences,
  headings, JSON, lists, blockquotes); 155-char cap with ellipsis
- Idempotent: only writes when at least one change applies
- 48 files updated across pages/_posts/

Draft relocation:
- Moved 34 posts with 'draft: true' from pages/_posts/ to pages/_drafts/
  (Jekyll standard location; included only with 'jekyll serve --drafts')

Manual stub descriptions:
- Added curated 1-line descriptions to 3 stub posts where the prose
  extractor had no body to work with (doc-scraper, bootstrap-your-theme,
  ai-to-create-ai)

Validation results (pages/_posts/):
- baseline:  124 files / 73 valid / 102 errors / SEO 54.5
- phase 2:    86 files / 86 valid /   0 errors / SEO 65.5

Build:
- Jekyll build still passes (exit 0); only 1 pre-existing Liquid warning
  in pages/_quests/0001/stack-attack.md (unrelated to cleanup)

author: bamr87
subject: chore(posts): markdown lint --fix + posts-scoped relaxed config
body:
Phase 3 of posts mass-cleanup.

Tooling:
- Installed markdownlint-cli2 (npm i -g markdownlint-cli2)
- Added pages/_posts/.markdownlint.json that extends the root config
  with blog-content-appropriate relaxations:
    - MD025 (single-h1):       false  (frontmatter title is H1)
    - MD060 (table-column):    false  (cosmetic; many compact tables)
    - MD036 (emphasis-as-h):   false  (legitimate stylistic use)
    - MD040 (fenced-lang):     false  (many short snippets)
    - MD033 (inline-html):     expanded allow-list with semantic +
                                full SVG element set

Auto-fixed (markdownlint-cli2 --fix, two passes):
- MD009 (trailing-spaces)
- MD012 (multiple-blank-lines)
- MD019 (no-multiple-space-atx)
- MD022 (blanks-around-headings)
- MD030 (list-marker-space)
- MD031 (blanks-around-fences)
- MD034 (no-bare-urls)
- MD047 (single-trailing-newline)
- ...and more

Lint issues: 1790 (baseline) -> 25 (after) = 98.6% reduction
Remaining 25 are content-quality items (mixed heading styles, duplicate
headings) that don't affect rendering or SEO; left for manual review.

Build: still passes (exit 0)
Frontmatter: still 100% valid / SEO 65.5

author: bamr87
subject: ci(posts): add posts-scoped markdownlint workflow + author standards README
body:
Phase 7 (CI hardening) of posts mass cleanup.

Adds:
- .github/workflows/posts-markdown-lint.yml — runs markdownlint-cli2
  against pages/_posts/ on PRs that touch posts. Uses the relaxed
  pages/_posts/.markdownlint.json that extends the repo-root config.
  Workflow_dispatch supports --fix mode for batch repairs.
- pages/_posts/README.md — single source of truth for posts authoring
  conventions: directory layout, file naming, required frontmatter,
  validation tooling, link hygiene, preview images, draft lifecycle,
  and the November-2025 cleanup metrics table.

The frontmatter-validation.yml workflow already covers pages/**/*.md
on PRs, so posts inherit that automatically.
